items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: So we played the tune once, I mean played through the arrangement, and then it came time for the solo section and Wes just soloed.

ctx.x: Okay, it was “Misty” you’re right. So you’ve got like laa-chord-note-chord, with the melody on top. And then chord-chord-chord, da-da. It was kind of corny but it made you, it opened up my ears to this kind of harmony. But I didn’t know what I was playing. I just did it by rote. And then later I learned that this was the one chord and this was the four chord, and this was like a subdominant minor. But I mean that’s when I went to school. And then I started to put together, then I started to hear it. And then once…
And the modes and that kind of thing.
